div.head: VI As 10
div.ab: Teoðe: Þæt þa witan ealle sealdan heora wedd ealle togædere þam arcebiscope æt Þunresfelda, þa Ælfeah Stybb ⁊ Brihtnoð Oddan sunu cóman togeanes þam gemote þæs cinges worde, þæt ælc gerefa náme þæt wedd on his agenre scire, þæt hi ealle þæt frið swa healdan woldan, swa Æþelstan cyng hit geræd hæfð ⁊ his witan ǽrest æt Gréatanléa ⁊ eft æt Exanceastre ⁊ syððan æt Fæfresham ⁊ feorðan syððe æt Þunresfelda beforan þam arcebiscope ⁊ eallum þam bisceopan ⁊ his witum, þe se cyng silf namode, þe þæron wæron, þæt man þas domas healdan sceoldan, þe on þissum gemote gesette wæron, buton þam þe þær ær ofadóne wæron; þæt wæs Sunnandæges cyping, ⁊ þæt man mid fulre gewitnesse ⁊ getreowe moste ceapian butan porte.

Tenth: The councillors, all in a body, gave their solemn pledges to the archbishop at Thundersfield, when Alfeah Stybb and Brihtnoth, the son of Odda, attended the assembly at the request of the king: that every reeve should exact a pledge from his own shire, that they would all observe the decrees for the public security which King Ethelstan and his councillors had enacted, first at Grately, and afterwards at Exeter, and then at Faversham, and on a fourth occasion at Thundersfield, in the presence of the archbishop and all the bishops and the members of the royal council nominated by the king himself who were present ; [and] that the decrees should be observed, which were established at this meeting, except those which had been abrogated ; namely, the decrees relating to trading on Sunday and to bargaining outside a town in the presence of ample and trustworthy witnesses.

Decimum, quod sapientes omnes dederunt uadium suum insimul archiepiscopo apud þunresfeldam, quando Ælfeach Stybb et Brihtnodus Odonis filius uenerunt ad concilium ex uerbo (ore) regis, ut omnis prepositus uadium capiat in suo comitatu de pace seruanda, sicut Æþelstanus rex hoc consuluit et sapientes sui prius apud Grateleiam et postea Exonie et postea apud Fefresham et quarta uice apud Þunresfeldam coram archiepiscopo et episcopis et sapientibus, quos rex ipse nominauit, qui interfuerunt, ut iudicia conseruarentur, que in hoc concilio fuerant instituta, preter hoc quod ante erat (fuit) exceptum: id est negotiato dominice diei, et quod pleno testimonio et credibili possit emi extra portum.
